parsed.post: New personal best! 0.8457 -> 0.8328 by keeping the current configuration. The WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 and DEPTH=8 setup is very strong. Next, I'll follow the team trend and try reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to see if finer optimization improves convergence.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to pursue finer-grained optimization on the depth-8 model with warmup stabilization.
